articles.title: Bank of America’s Profit Climbs as Consumer Spending Rises
articles.mainIdea: Bank of America’s Profit Climbs as Consumer Spending Rises
articles.summary: The Wall Street Journal: Bank of America’s Profit Climbs as Consumer Spending Rises. Bank of America said its profit rose 12% in the fourth quarter of last year, as consumer spending rose and delinquencies on credit cards edged lower. The bank said spending on debit and credit cards rose 6%, while delinquencies of over 90 days on credit cards fell to 1.27% versus 1.35% a year ago. “With consumers and businesses proving resilient, as well as the regulatory environment and tax and trade policies coming into sharper focus, we expect further economic growth in the year ahead,” CEO Brian Moynihan said in a press release.
